;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]], [[Northwestern Syria offensive (April 2019–present)]]
**[[Sky News]] journalist [[Alex Crawford]] and her media team are fired on by [[Syrian Army]] tanks in the [[Tahrir al-Sham]]-held village of [[Hbit]], [[Idlib Governorate]], while covering the fighting there. Their guide, [[Bilal Abdul Kareem]], is injured by shrapnel to his chest. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/may/23/sky-news-journalist-and-crew-shot-at-by-syrian-government (''The Guardian'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Panasonic]] suspends shipments of certain hardware components to [[Huawei|Huawei Technologies Co. Ltd.]] to comply with [[United States|U.S.]] restrictions on the company. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-huawei-panasonic/panasonic-suspends-some-component-shipments-to-huawei-amid-u-s-blacklist-idUSKCN1SS32U (Reuters)]
*[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces a second aid package worth $16 billion for farmers impacted by the {{nowrap|[[China–United States trade war]]}}. [https://www.cnbc.com/2019/05/23/trump-to-give-16-billion-to-farmers-hurt-by-trade-war-sonny-perdue.html (CNBC)] [https://www.foxbusiness.com/markets/trump-second-round-farmer-aid-us-china-trade (Fox Business)]

;Law and crime
*[[John Walker Lindh]], the first person to be convicted of a crime in the [[War on Terror]], is released on [[United States federal probation and supervised release|probation]] from a U.S. federal prison after serving {{nowrap|17 years}} of a {{nowrap|20-year}} sentence.  Lindh has refused to renounce Islamist extremism and will be on probation for three years. [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] condemns the early release. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/05/22/politics/john-walker-lindh-american-taliban/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.apnews.com/24e30be3a75949b7aa3b30946703140d ({{nowrap|Associated Press}})]
*The U.S. city of [[Baltimore]], [[Maryland]], has been battling a [[ransomware]] attack that has blocked government email accounts and disabled online payments to city departments. The hackers breached the city's servers on May 7 and demanded $100,000 (£79,000) worth of [[Bitcoin]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-48371476 (BBC News)]
*[[Interpol]]'s Operation Blackwrist arrests nine people in [[Australia]], [[Thailand]] and the [[United States]], and rescues 50 children in connection with a 63,000-member online [[pedophilia]] ring. More arrests are expected. Investigators from nearly 60 countries  participated in this operation. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/interpol-child-sex-abuse-network-thailand-australia-blackwrist-11558670 (ChannelNewsAsia)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/pedophilia-ring-dark-web-interpol-operation-blackwrist-thailand-us-australia-children-rescued/ (CBS News)]
*[[Indictment and arrest of Julian Assange]]
**The [[United States Department of Justice]] charges [[WikiLeaks]] founder [[Julian Assange]] with 17 counts of violating the [[Espionage Act of 1917|Espionage Act]], including provisions that prohibit a conspiracy to obtain, receive and disclose national defense information, attempting to crack computer passwords, and unlawful receipt of sensitive information such as [[United States Department of State|State Department]] communications and [[United States Department of Defense|Defense Department]] logs. [https://www.npr.org/2019/05/23/726282766/u-s-brings-new-charges-against-julian-assange-in-war-logs-state-cables-case (NPR)]
*Aftermath of the [[Mueller special counsel investigation]] and [[Crossfire Hurricane (FBI investigation)]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]], in a directive, orders the [[United States Intelligence Community|Intelligence Community]] to cooperate with [[United States Attorney General|U.S. Attorney General]] [[William Barr|William Barr's]] review of the origins of the Special Counsel investigation. The order allows Attorney General Barr to [[Classified information in the United States|declassify information]] he sees fit for the review process. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-usa-trump-russia-barr/trump-orders-intelligence-community-to-cooperate-with-review-on-russia-probe-origins-idUSKCN1SU00T (Reuters)] [https://www.foxnews.com/politics/trump-gives-ag-barr-authority-to-declassify-documents-related-to-2016-campaign-surveillance (Fox News)]
*American [[serial killer]] [[Bobby Joe Long]] who murdered 10 women in the [[Tampa Bay Area]] during an eight month period in 1984 is executed by [[lethal injection]]. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/bobby-joe-long-execution-serial-killer-executed-today-for-murdering-10-women-survivor-witnessed-execution/ (CBS News)]


;Politics and elections
*[[2019 European Parliament election]]
**[[European citizen]]s in the [[2019 European Parliament election in the United Kingdom|United Kingdom]] and the [[2019 European Parliament election in the Netherlands|Netherlands]] vote in the first day of 2019's European Parliament elections. [http://www.europarl.europa.eu/at-your-service/en/be-heard/elections (European Parliament)]
*[[2019 Indian general election]]
**The [[Bharatiya Janata Party]], led by [[Indian Prime Minister]] [[Narendra Modi]], wins a [[landslide victory]] in the latest Indian general election. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-election/indias-modi-stuns-opposition-with-huge-election-win-idUSKCN1SS2YR (Reuters)]
*[[2019 Malawian general election]]
**The Malawi Electoral Commission reports, with 75% of the vote counted, President [[Peter Mutharika]] leads with 40.44% of votes, the opposition [[Malawi Congress Party]]'s [[Lazarus Chakwera]] has 35.34%, and Deputy President [[Saulos Chilima]] received 18.35% of the votes cast in Tuesday's presidential election. [https://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFKCN1ST1A0-OZATP (Reuters)]
*The [[French Senate]] approves the reworded autonomy statute for [[French Polynesia]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/389873/senate-approves-reworded-autonomy-statute-for-french-polynesia (Radio New Zealand)]

;Science and technology

**Eighteen [[Earth analog|Earth-like]] exoplanets are discovered via a new algorithm. [https://newatlas.com/earth-sized-exoplanets-new-algorithm/59806/ (New Atlas)] [http://spaceref.com/exoplanets/18-earth-sized-exoplanets-discovered.html (Space Ref)]
